title: Envelope
description:
The envelope of every v5 message: as v4's, with `observed_at` optional
(change 2) and v5's `SchemaId`.

event_id.description: Events only: unique per event, for deduplication on redelivery.

last_event_seq.description: Scenes only: the `seq` of the last event published before this scene.

observed_at.description:
Source time of what is claimed. `None` for a message that observes no
sample (a reception change).

profile.description: The configuration the engine ran with.

published_at_ms.description: Wall clock; set by publishing, never by the core.

schema.description: What the body is: a scene or an event.

seq.description: Contiguous from 1 per run and per schema; a gap is a lost message.

timing.description: Scenes only: how long the shell took with the sample.

Attention.description: What was looked at during the turn, in order.

looks.description: One per sense considered, in the order of the turn.

Bed.description: The bed: who is believed in it, seen or held.

held.description: Who is retained in the bed without being seen, oldest first.

seen.description:
Occupants seen in the bed, in the stable count. It is belief: if the
scene did not come from an observation, `republished` says so.

since.description: Since when `state` holds; `None` before the first turn.

unexplained.description:
Stable bodies in the bed that are not occupants: they appeared without
anyone coming from the floor. They do not count in the room.

oneOf.description: Nobody in the bed.
At least one visible occupant in the bed's stable count.
Nobody seen, with retained occupants.
The bed geometry does not apply to the image.

items.description: One per admitted person, after consolidating overlapping boxes.

status.description: Whether there was a reading, with or without zones.

BodiesStatus.description: Whether this sample has bodies to show.

oneOf.description: The detector read and each body has its zone.
The detector read, but the bed geometry does not apply: no zones.

No body reading in this sample (the detector failed or nothing was
decoded).

BodySeen.description: A body admitted in this sample.

knee_deg.description:
The hip–knee–ankle angle, in degrees, when the body was doubtful and
its pose was asked before believing: bent, the room put it in bed
(white book, volume VII, ch. 15).

near_bed.description: On the floor: whether it touches the grown bed. Absent in bed.

shadow.description:
Where it falls for the geometry's shadow: absent unless the profile
asks for it. It decides nothing (white book, volume VII, ch. 11).

zone.description: In bed or on the floor; `None` when the bed geometry does not apply.

BodyShadow.description: The shadow of one body. It decides nothing.

centroid.description: The box's centre on the mattress: what decides the zone today.

near_bed.description:
On the floor for the shadow: whether the support is within the
shadow's distance of the bed. Absent in bed or without the bed's size.

share.description: The share of the box over the mattress, on an 8 × 8 grid.

support.description: The centre of the box's lower edge, where a standing body rests.

support_distance_m.description:
How far the support is from the bed, in metres; zero inside. Absent
without the bed's size.

zone.description:
The zone the support says: in bed within the shadow's margin, on the
floor past it. Absent without the bed's size.

BodySource.description: Which detector the admitted body came from.

oneOf.description: The main detector, over the whole frame.
The finer detector, over the bed.

git.description: The commit it was built from.

Calibration.description:
The empty bed's calibration: as in v4, with the depth named for its scale
(change 4).

oneOf.description: The empty bed has not been learned.
The empty bed was learned.

reference.description: Its depth, on the depth model's relative scale.

since.description: The sample it was learned in; `None` if the profile brought it.

Cell.description:
The cell of a transition: `before:seen:after`, the natural key of the row.
Each part is written as decimal digits if all its counts are below
10; otherwise as a tuple (`(12,1,1)`).

Counts.description: What is seen in each zone, stabilized or yet to stabilize.

Evidence.description: What was admitted in this sample, apart from the stabilized belief.

bodies.description: The bodies admitted from the person detectors.

faces.description: The faces admitted from the face detector.

FaceSeen.description: A face admitted in this sample.

on_subject.description: Whether it lies on the subject seen in this sample.

reason.description: Why faces were not looked for; only with `skipped`.

status.description: Whether faces were looked for and what came of it.

FacesStatus.description: What happened with faces in this sample.

oneOf.description: Looked for, and at least one admitted.
Looked for, and none admitted.
The face detector failed.
Not looked for; `reason` says why.

FailureKind.description: How a look failed, as published.

oneOf.description: The shell could not complete the probe (shutdown).
The sense ran and failed (model or backend error).

Floor.description: Off the bed, no longer being seen is leaving the room: nobody is retained.

seen.description: Occupants seen off the bed, in the stable count.

Geometry.description: Whether the delimited bed matches the incoming image.

oneOf.description: The image has the resolution the bed was delimited for.
The resolution is not the declared one: "in bed" cannot be claimed.

actual.description: The resolution of the incoming image.

declared.description: The resolution the bed was delimited for.

Held.description: Someone who stopped being seen in bed without an observed exit.

bbox.description: Where they were last seen, in image pixels.

check.description:
Whether a verifier looked since: only with a verifier configured
(white book, volume III). It never moves the count.

last_seen.description: The last sample they were seen in.

HeldCheck.description: The provenance of a held body: whether a verifier looked, and when.

looked.description: The sample it looked at; `None` while unverified.

HeldCheckState.description: How much observation backs a body held in bed.

oneOf.description: Nobody looked since it stopped being seen.
A verifier saw it: the belief has an observation behind it.

A verifier looked and did not see it. It is not released: the blanket
hides it from every verifier (book 4, frontier 3).

LayerRef.description: A layer of the profile, by name and revision.

version.description: Its revision; `0` while layers are not versioned.

Look.description:
An entry of attention's ledger (rule 12): what was decided to look at or
not, and what happened.

outcome.description: Asked, with what came back, or skipped, with why.

LookKind.description: What was asked to be looked at.

oneOf.description: The main person detector.
The face detector.
The finer detector over the bed, when the subject is lost.
The subject's pose.
A doubtful body's pose, before believing.
The depth at image points.
The depth of the empty bed, to learn it.
The slow verifier, asked about a crop.
A crop kept for a burst to the verifier.
A look was requested.

spent_ms.description: What the shell measured; the core only records it (rule 9).

oneOf.description: It was decided not to look, with a reason.

The sense read: how many candidates, and why those that did not count
were discarded.

candidates.description: How many the sense returned, before admission.

rejected.description: The discarded ones, grouped by reason.

oneOf.description: The sense failed: it proves nothing (rule 1).
The verifier took the request: the answer comes in a later turn.
The shell kept the crop for a burst.

counted.description: Whether it counts for the burst: sharp enough for this camera.

sharpness.description: How sharp the shell measured it.

MapState.description:
The map's state, as v5 publishes it: as in v4, with `calibration` named for
its scale (change 4).

bed.description: The bed's four corners on the image, clockwise.

calibration.description: What the map learned about the empty bed.

focus.description: The main detector's focus, when the policy has one.

geometry.description: Whether the delimited bed applies to this image.

headboard.description: Where faces are looked for when nobody is in sight.

Mode.description: The mode of the layer-0 machine: the name of its state.

oneOf.description: Nobody in the room.
One occupant, off the bed.
One occupant in bed, seen in the stable count.
One occupant in bed, retained.
More than one occupant.

Pending.description: A new count that has not stabilized yet.

counts.description: The new count per zone, waiting to hold.

duration.description: Source seconds it has held, against the required dwell.

Phase.description:
The phase of rule 6: until the first climb into bed, whatever appears in
it is adopted.

oneOf.description: The bed has no history yet: whoever is clearly seen in it is adopted.
Someone climbed into bed from the floor: the bed only rises from it.

PlanePoint.description:
A point of the image and where it falls in the bed's coordinates on a
plane: `u` across, `v` from the foot (0) to the headboard (1).

u.description: Across the bed: 0 and 1 are its sides.

v.description: Along the bed: 0 the foot, 1 the headboard.

Point.description: A point on the image plane.

Profile.description: The configuration the engine ran with, as the consumer needs to compare runs.

camera.description: The camera layer of the profile.

hash.description: Two runs with the same hash believed with the same policy and map.

resident.description: The resident layer of the profile; `None` while there is none.

senses.description:
What each configured sense looks with. `hash` already covers them; this
names them for whoever watches, as in v2. Empty if the shell does not
report them.

ProfileHash.description: Hash of the effective policy the engine ran with.

Progress.description: A quantity reached against the one required.

oneOf.description: Observed in this sample.
Observed earlier and retained without a current observation.

since.description: The last sample it was observed in.

oneOf.description: Computed earlier and still valid because the subject did not move.

since.description: The sample it was computed in.

Quad.description: A quadrilateral: the bed seen in perspective.

Rect.description: An axis-aligned rectangle: top-left and bottom-right corners.

RejectReason.description: Why a candidate did not count as evidence.

oneOf.description: Another class than a person.
Below the policy's minimum confidence.
Outside the region where the look was requested.

RepublishReason.description: Why the scene is republished without a new observation.

oneOf.description: The sample did not decode.
The decoder produced no image.
The sensor state changed.
The main detector failed: the belief is that of the last observation.

Republished.description: A republished scene: what happened and when what it claims is from.

observed_at.description: The last observed sample; `None` if there has been none yet.

reason.description: Why this sample was not observed.

Room.description: The room: the machine's mode, the phase and the last cell.

last_cell.description: The cell of the last transition; `None` before the first.

occupants.description: How many people are in the room, seen or retained.

pending.description: A new count that has not held long enough yet.

phase.description: Whether the bed has history yet (rule 6).

SampleRef.description:
Which sample and when, in source time. It is the domain's only clock
(rule 9).

sequence.description: The sample's number, increasing within the run.

session.description: The stream session: a reconnection starts a new one.

source_secs.description: The sample's presentation time, comparable only within its session.

Scene.description:
The scene of a sample, as v5 publishes it: as in v4 except for the subject
and the map, which name the changed types (changes 3 and 4).

attention.description: What the core looked at in this turn, and why not the rest.

evidence.description: What was admitted in this sample.

floor.description: Who is seen off the bed.

frame.description: The image size the turn worked on; `None` before the first image.

map.description: The bed geometry and what the map learned.

republished.description: Present only if this scene does not come from a new observation (rule 2).

room.description: How many are in the room and the machine's mode.

sensor.description: The reception, as the shell reported it.

subject.description: The room's only occupant, when there is exactly one.

SchemaId.description: Which schema a v5 message carries.

oneOf.description: One scene per sample.
Every event, in order.

SenseProfile.description: The model and thresholds of a sense.

backend_confidence.description: Below this score the backend does not return the candidate.

min_confidence.description: Below this score the policy does not admit the candidate.

min_keypoint_score.description:
The pose only: below this score a keypoint is not seen, and the core
neither measures nor reasons with it. Absent in every other sense.

model.description: The model file, without its path.

SensorState.description: The reception state, as the shell reports it. It says nothing about the bed.

oneOf.description: Opening the stream.
Samples are arriving.
Connected, but no sample within the stall timeout.
The stream dropped; trying again.

SessionId.description: Source session. Source time is only comparable within one session.

ShadowPlane.description: The plane a point was measured on.

oneOf.description: The bed's footprint on the floor.
The mattress, when there is no footprint.
This sense was not requested.
No body and no delimited headboard: nowhere to look for faces.
This loss was already reinforced: once per loss.
Nobody was seen in bed: there is no loss to reinforce.
The geometry does not apply: where the bed is, is unknown.
The subject did not move since the last pose: the previous one holds.

The subject was posed in this turn as a doubtful body, before
believing: that pose is read without looking again.
The subject is retained, not seen in this sample.
Without a pose there are no points to measure depth at.
Someone is in the room: a person is not learned as the bed.
Faces are in sight: someone may be covering the bed.
The last attempt failed and the retry delay has not passed yet.
A verification is already in flight: one at a time per camera.
The camera's verification budget for the hour is spent.

The doubt cleared while the burst was being collected: nothing is asked
(white book, volume III, ch. 12, V17).
What the burst asked about no longer holds: it is dropped unasked.

Source.description: Identity of the publishing shell; the core does not build these values.

camera.description: The camera within the site (a subject token).

run_id.description: One per process start: a new run restarts every numbering.

site.description: The site the camera belongs to (a subject token).

SourceSecs.description: Seconds of source time (video PTS) within a session.

Subject.description: The subject: as in v4, without `verdict` (change 3).

bbox.description: The subject's box, in image pixels.

SubjectDepth.description:
The subject's depth, on the depth model's relative scale (the unit is
`RelativeDepth`): the name says what the value is.

provenance.description: Measured in this sample, or stable with the pose.

relative.description:
The median of the subject's measured points, on the depth model's
relative scale.

Timing.description:
How long the shell took with a sample, in wall-clock milliseconds. It is
measured by the shell and never decides anything (rule 9).

processing_ms.description: The whole turn: decoding, every look and the projection.

wait_ms.description: From the sample's arrival to the start of its turn.

oneOf.description: The slow verifier: a vision-language model over a crop of the bed.
The delimited bed.
The rest of the room.
